purpose: ReceivingPolicyService pure receiving policy: base quantity, supplier exception, SKU commitment drift, tracking and lot dates, minimum receipt life with the Confirm and business-date checks, over-receipt and duplicate dimensions; case 31 checks agreement of the two Inventory-bound reasons with Inventory's real normalizePurchaseReceipt (normalization only); Opening parser and precheck prevent invalid/double posting. Explicit local HTTP/MySQL checks exercise durable result, protected full-file posting, stale SKU, normalized Lot key, idempotency and rollback.
data: Pure in-memory inputs only: 31 registrations, 135 calls (113 policy, 22 Inventory normalizer: 8 positive, 14 negative); at most 4 details per call, longest string 504 bytes; no DB, network, fixture file or timer; Opening routine adds 7 in-memory cases, ≤5,001 generated small CSV lines only in one parser count check, other cases at most 6 lines, no DB, network, load or timers. Explicit local suite only: 9 cases, fresh isolated MySQL26.7 schema, 1 warehouse, 2 bins and 2 SKUs, at most 2 positive rows per file, 2 actors and 1 controlled second-link failure.
concurrency: Existing scheduling unchanged. Opening routines use one test process per file with serial cases. Explicit local suite uses one process, one isolated MySQL, one HTTP app; no load.
repetitions: One invocation per suite per applicable run.
thresholds: All 31 pass with 0 fail and 0 skip by the runner's own counts; existing coverage floors unchanged (global 92/83/90 and existing per-file floors); no timing threshold; Opening routine 7/7 PASS and explicit local 9/9 PASS, both zero skips, no new performance threshold.
trigger: Existing ci.yml server coverage shards (8) on an admitted PR dispatch, push to main and the weekly schedule; no new job; Opening unit files use existing discovery. Opening integration requires explicit local server/scripts/inventoryOpening.integration.js execution and two existing test flags. No CI discovery, job, flag or capacity change.
cost: No new CI job, DB fixture, browser job or capacity. Opening routine runs 7 small unit cases. No isolated CI overhead measurement. Explicit local 9-case runner took about 1.3 s after fresh schema migration.

cases: TASK-028 P028-01 calculateBaseQuantity 精確換算正整數 Base 並正規化數量
TASK-028 P028-02 calculateBaseQuantity 拒絕 0、負數、指數、超過 6 位小數、空字串同非字串
TASK-028 P028-03 calculateBaseQuantity 非整數 Base 或非法 factor 係 UOM_CONVERSION_INVALID
TASK-028 P028-04 calculateBaseQuantity 遵守系統 Base 上限
TASK-028 P028-05 Active Supplier 唔使原因，送咗都唔保存
TASK-028 P028-06 Suspended／Archived Supplier 要原因（BR-038）
TASK-028 P028-07 Blocked Supplier 要原因而且每個 detail 都要 QUARANTINED
TASK-028 P028-08 已確認 PO 嘅 Supplier 唔可能係 draft、pending_approval 或未知狀態，fail closed
TASK-028 P028-09 一般原因：空白要求原因，少於 5 或多過 500 code point 拒絕，前後空白會 trim
TASK-028 P028-10 SKU 冇變就冇 warning，原因唔保存
TASK-028 P028-11 Item provider 嘅 warning 原文傳出，要原因（BR-039）
TASK-028 P028-12 Purchasing 自己偵測 Tracking、Base UOM 同 Purchase UOM 改變，並同 provider warning 合併排序
TASK-028 P028-13 SKU projection 冇咗或者 skuId 唔對，fail closed
TASK-028 P028-14 Tracking none：空值當冇，有 Lot／Expiry／Manufacture 就拒絕
TASK-028 P028-15 Tracking batch：要 Lot，trim 後保留大細楷，Expiry 選填
TASK-028 P028-16 Tracking batch_expiry：Lot 同 Expiry 一齊要求
TASK-028 P028-17 非法日期、生產日期遲過到期日、超長或含 control character 嘅 Lot 都拒絕
TASK-028 P028-18 serial 或未知 Tracking fail closed，唔降級（AC-028）
TASK-028 P028-19 Minimum Receipt Life 門檻取 PO 快照同目前值較嚴格嘅非空值
TASK-028 P028-20 剩餘效期等於門檻就合格；少一日而冇權限冇原因就 MINIMUM_RECEIPT_LIFE_FAILED
TASK-028 P028-21 有 override 權限加原因就產生同 Inventory 一致嘅 evidence；原因空白仍然拒絕
TASK-028 P028-22 冇 override 權限但送原因就 EXPIRY_OVERRIDE_DENIED
TASK-028 P028-23 已過期任何權限都唔可以 override；當日到期唔算過期但仍要過門檻
TASK-028 P028-24 冇 Expiry 就唔計 Minimum Receipt Life（同 Inventory 現況一致）
TASK-028 P028-25 少收唔會有超收，亦唔要求原因（FR-VAL-015）
TASK-028 P028-26 超收按提交前 Outstanding 計並要求原因（AC-034）
TASK-028 P028-27 Outstanding 已係 0 都可以超收但要原因；數量唔係 safe integer 就係程式錯誤
TASK-028 P028-28 同一 PO line 可以拆 Lot／位置／Status；Lot 大細楷唔同就係唔同 bucket（AC-023）
TASK-028 P028-29 同一 physical bucket 唔可以重複，唔理輸入 UOM，Lot 前後空白唔算唔同
TASK-028 P028-30 Expiry 唔可以早過業務收貨日期，即使 Confirm 日仲未到期（FR-VAL-007、TL Q1）
TASK-028 P028-31 傳去 Inventory 嘅兩個原因按 trim 後 5～500 UTF-8 byte 單行，同 Inventory normalizePurchaseReceipt 判斷一致
